methodology: Transparent empirical-Bayes random-effects meta-regression on controlled set-treatment pseudo-effects; DerSimonian-Laird tau² and precision-weighted partial pooling.
shrinkage_method: lambda=tau²/(tau²+sampling variance); small/noisy cells shrink more strongly toward the universe population effect.
